set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 3-5. Prove a pure typed applicative-first decode plan for one nontrivial representation, bind its logical slots to LNA-HDF5 payloads, and replace canonical closed dispatch with namespaced keys, a narrow representation envelope, and an explicit immutable registry. Close only when in-memory and LNA selected reconstruction commute, persistence preserves the representation artifact exactly, unknown representations remain structurally inspectable, and legacy LNA behavior survives behind a named family.
set.title: EPIC RRA-B: typed representation planning and LNA interop
